units: <cite ref="Sifrei Devarim 26:2">Sifré Deut. 26</cite> <he>יהיו מחזירים איתו בע׳</he> they shall lead him around in a circuit (expose him to public disgrace; <cite ref="Devarim Rabbah 2">Deut. R. s. 2</cite>; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 810:8">Yalk. ib. 810</cite> <he>בקוּמְפּוֹן</he>).

<cite ref="Bava Kamma 113a:21">B. Kam. 113ᵃ</cite> <he>באין עליו בע׳</he> we bewilder him by subtle arguments; <he>אין באין עליו בע׳ וכ׳</he> you must not do it, because you must sanctify the name of the Lord (by your integrity in dealing with a gentile).
